messages:
Maria: Quick question — the eviction backpressure shim we landed yesterday seems to be degrading cold-read p99s for small tenants. Anyone seen this?

Jon: Saw a spike in eviction_pending_ms on shard logs around 15:30 UTC. Could be batch eviction blocking worker threads.

Li: Are we doing synchronous work during eviction? I remember a sync path left for lease handoff correctness.

Kevin: The shim adds a per-shard token-bucket that stalls reads when mem_pressure > threshold. It was to avoid OOM, but it might be too coarse-grained for small tenants.

Shreya: Repro steps? I can run a local sim with --eviction-delay-ms=50 and mixed tenant load.

Maria: Attaching quick log excerpt for the hot shard: 
```log
evict: tenant=t42 shard=3 pending=87 delay_us=12000
read: tenant=t42 shard=3 wait_us=15000
```

CacheBot: Metric alert: eviction_pending > 50 for shard=3 (t42) — triggered 5 times in last 10m.

Jon: Options I see:
- make backpressure per-tenant instead of per-shard (better fairness)
- convert eviction to async with a bounded background queue
- short-circuit tiny reads under a size threshold to avoid blocking
Tradeoffs: per-tenant buckets add overhead, async eviction changes memory churn and correctness surface area.

Kevin: Async eviction + bounded queue seems reasonable. Need an in-flight tracking pointer so read-after-write still sees recently-written prefixes that haven't been evicted yet.

Li: Warning: async eviction increases churn; we must cap the queue and surface eviction_queue_len + eviction_pending_count metrics. Also define invariants for "read sees latest write" under async eviction.

Shreya: Test plan suggestion: 1) add eviction_pending_count & eviction_queue_len metrics, 2) run e2e with small tenants interleaved heavily, 3) A/B flag per-tenant to toggle new behavior.

Maria: I'll spin up a small spike PR to add the metrics + config knobs. If we go async, we should add a read-fast-path that bypasses the token bucket when the prefix index shows the key exists. That will fix most cold reads.

Jon: +1. For defaults I propose queue_size=1024, delay_cutoff_ms=10. I'll pair with Maria on the PR.

Kevin: Also add an opt-out: eviction_sync_on_hot_prefix = true/false so we can keep sync eviction for prefixes with very recent writes to preserve strong read-after-write semantics.

Maria: Action items: Maria + Jon -> PR for metrics + bounded async eviction (target: EOD Tue). Shreya -> e2e tests. Li -> formalize safety invariants for R/W correctness. I'll post results in this thread. :thumbsup:
